Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

optcompR 0.1.0

  • First release.
  • Modeling: continuous, integer and binary variables, parameters, vectorized linear, quadratic and nonlinear expressions with sparse Matrix support, ranged constraints and named blocks.
  • Classification into LP, MILP, QP, MIQP, QCQP, MIQCQP, NLP and MINLP with recorded convexity evidence, and capability-aware solver selection.
  • Backends: HiGHS (LP, MILP, convex QP, ranging, warm starts), SCIP (global MIQCQP), OSQP (convex QP), NLopt SLSQP (local NLP) and ROI plugins.
  • Results with standardized statuses, duals as derivatives of the optimal value, independent feasibility and KKT diagnostics (opt_check()).
  • Exact gradients, Jacobians and Lagrangian Hessians; external R functions with supplied, jaxR or labeled finite difference gradients (opt_function()).
  • Sensitivity ranging, fixed relaxations of MILPs and scenario sweeps.
  • Multiobjective scalarizations: opt_weighted(), opt_lexicographic(), opt_epsilon_constraint().
  • Exact feasibility checks and optimality certificates for LP and MILP through z3r (opt_z3_check(), opt_z3_certify()).
  • Conversion to and from symcompR expressions; MPS and LP export.
  • Fifteen vignettes and a pkgdown site.

Developed by Adam R Sophie.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
